summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Saklio MVP (Turkish receipt/warranty tracking app). Backend: 27/27 pytest tests passing across auth, products CRUD with return_status/warranty_status computation, dashboard, gmail preview+import (7 products), notifications, warranty claim (GPT-5.4), return verdict, assistant chat (GPT-5.4), scan (GPT-5.4 vision), image upload/download, seed-demo. Frontend: onboarding (4 slides) -> register -> home dashboard (greeting, act-now countdown rings, İade Merkezi summary, quick actions, recent products), My Stuff tab (category chips), Activity tab (İade Merkezi/Garantilerim + Aktif/Yakında/Süresi dolmuş chips), Profile (settings rows + sign out), Notifications (derived alerts), Theme settings (3 cards Soft/Dark/Color), Gmail connect, Add-manually form, Assistant chat all render and integrate with backend. Turkish UI throughout. No deprecated Expo packages detected (uses expo-camera correctly, react-native-safe-area-context, no expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch).

issues: React Native Web console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow), and 'transform-origin' invalid DOM property (use transformOrigin). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up in StyleSheet definitions.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Replace deprecated 'shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius' with 'boxShadow' shorthand in StyleSheet to silence RN-web warnings.
(Optional cosmetic) Fix 'transform-origin' -> 'transformOrigin' in animated style props.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses async endpoints correctly; MongoDB _id excluded via clean(); env vars used properly; JWT auth solid.
compute_status thresholds (>3 active, >=0 ending, <0 expired) verified via tests.
Gmail import creates 7 products; seed-demo creates 4 and is idempotent.
scan endpoint correctly strips data: URI prefix and parses JSON with fallback regex.
download_file requires token via query or Authorization header — correctly protects owner_id.
seed_data_creation: Tests register fresh users per run (email prefix ui+/test+). Seeded via POST /api/seed-demo and /api/gmail/import. All test products prefixed TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Auth via /api/auth/register->JWT->Bearer. testIDs available on frontend: login-email/password, register-name/email/password/submit, tab-home/stuff/activity/profile, tab-scan (FAB), product-card-<id>. Onboarding stores completion in AsyncStorage — clear localStorage to re-see onboarding. Camera scan (expo-camera) cannot render preview on web preview environment — validate scan pipeline via backend /api/scan instead.
